author: Reuters
description:
President Trump said he would respect the results of the November midterms "if they're honest elections," when asked by a reporter. 
 
The US Justice Department has asked Washington state not to count any mail ballots received from more than 400 residents who it says may not be US citizens, opening a new front in the Trump administration's push to expand control of election administration ahead of the November 3 vote.
 
The letter, which resembled a request earlier this month that California not count any ballots received from around 20,000 alleged noncitizens, marked an escalation in the Trump administration's pressure on state election officials over alleged noncitizen voting. Multiple state audits and independent studies have found that voter fraud, including voting by noncitizens, is very rare and has not affected election outcomes.
 
#trump #election #midterms #politics #donaldtrump
title: Trump says he will respect midterm results 'if they're honest elections'
